# ConfigurationException

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Configuration.ConfigurationException`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Exception thrown when Dataverse configuration is invalid. Provides detailed context including property name, connection name, environment name, and resolution hints showing where the property can be configured.

Creates an exception for a missing required property with full context and resolution hints.

- Parameter `propertyName`: The name of the missing property (e.g., &quot;Url&quot;, &quot;ClientId&quot;).
- Parameter `connectionName`: The connection name (e.g., &quot;Primary&quot;, &quot;Secondary&quot;).
- Parameter `connectionIndex`: The zero-based index of the connection in the configuration array.
- Parameter `environmentName`: The environment name, or null for root-level configurations.
- Parameter `sectionName`: The configuration section name (default: &quot;Dataverse&quot;).

Returns: A ConfigurationException with formatted message and resolution hints.
